optimizedContext.value:
# Artifact AST

## Rules

- Every node plain object: required `type` (string, format-specific); optional `label` (selector `matches` field); optional `value` (`string|number|boolean|null`); optional `children` (ordered). `value` and `children` mutually exclusive; neither allowed (e.g. thematic-break); both forbidden.
- Markdown types: `document` (root, children); `section` (`label` = heading text sans `#`/whitespace, `level` 1–6, children); `paragraph` (`value` plain markdown inline); `list` (`ordered` bool, children); `list-item` (`label` item text, optional nested-list children); `code-block` (`label` language, `value` code); `thematic-break` (void). Sections nest by relative depth: child of nearest preceding strictly-lower `level` (levels need not be contiguous).
- YAML types: `document` (children = top-level pairs or single sequence); `mapping` (children = `pair`s); `pair` (`label` key; `value` scalar OR children single `mapping`/`sequence`); `sequence` (children = `sequence-item`s); `sequence-item` (`value` scalar OR children single `mapping`/`sequence`).
- JSON types: `document` (children = single root); `object` (children = `property`s); `property` (`label` key; `value` scalar OR children single `object`/`array`); `array` (children = `array-item`s); `array-item` (`value` scalar OR children single `object`/`array`).
- Plaintext types: `document` (children); `paragraph` (`value`); `line` (`value`).
- Round-trip serialize: preserve all `label`/`value`/`children`. Markdown: heading levels, `ordered`, code languages, nesting; inline formatting intent in AST metadata for unmodified nodes; serializer style markers (`bullet`/`emphasis`/`strong`) follow source when unambiguous else deterministic project conventions. YAML: key order; comments where CST supports. JSON: key order; two-space indent. Unrepresentable inline content preserved as-is in `value` strings — adapter does not decompose inline nodes.

## Constraints

- `value` and `children` mutually exclusive on any node.
- `label` only on node types with primary identifier; absent on document, paragraph, list, sequence, array, object, thematic-break.
- All field values JSON-serializable — no functions, circular refs, class instances.
- Adapter sole component that may parse/serialize native format; all others operate exclusively on normalized AST.
